comments.body:
2 ships (i think its Caravel), both 122 dura, 17 sailors in 1, 28 sailors in another. Cannon deals 1 dmg per shot. melee power: 37 atk, 28 def. drops Shamshirs

when i fought it it spawned offshore at the south of the island Dublin is sitting on, closer to Plymouth than Dublin.

Not kidding when i said its easy :)
